# graphiant_custom_app (Data Source)

Looks up a single Graphiant custom app by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_custom_app" "internal_wiki" {
  id = 12345
}

output "internal_wiki_policy_references" {
  value = data.graphiant_custom_app.internal_wiki.policy_reference_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Custom app identifier.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form description of the custom app.
- `ip_lists` (List of String)
- `ip_prefixes` (List of String)
- `ip_protocol` (String)
- `name` (String) Custom app name.
- `port_ranges` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--port_ranges))
- `url` (String) URL or domain this app matches.

<a id="nestedatt--port_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `port_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `lower` (Number)
- `upper` (Number)
